subject: xlim and ylim discarded in mapBars (and maybe mapPies?)

messages.subject: xlim and ylim discarded in mapBars (and maybe mapPies?)
parts:
Hi there, hi Andy,

I know I already sent you an email some time ago about some thing that would deserve a bugfix: the xlim and ylim arguments one can provide the mapBars and mapPies functions with have simply no effect. Only the "mapRegion" parameter is taken into account.
You fixed this for the mapBubbles function some time ago, but I now have the same problem with mapBars.

In your answer to me at the end of March, you mentioned that it was tricky because you use the xlim and ylim to dimension your circles/bars... Any progress on this?

Thanks very much for your excellent work on this package.
